BiblicalUsage: The female devotee was a woman given to the service of a false god by prostitution: there shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel; Judah asked the men of the place, where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side. Hosea says they sacrifice with harlots, and the people that doth not understand shall fall.
TheologicalSignificance: What this word shows me is what idolatry does to a people: it does not stay in the shrine, it moves into the streets and the houses by the temple, and a nation is judged by whether it clears it out. My position is that the law's ban is absolute, because the shrine prostitute is the proof that the worship itself is rotten.
